spans.text:
Do not fix typos, reformat, or reword tool results. Users expect their real data,
not an AI's editorial interpretation of it.
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and information integrity. It instructs the agent to never make up capabilities, to ask clarifying questions rather than guess, and to preserve tool output exactly as returned without editorial interpretation. This protects data provenance and prevents fabrication.

spans.text:
Return a structured routing decision in the standard format — never start
   improvising tool calls that belong to a sub-agent.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly enforces tool/action safety by prohibiting the router agent from executing tool calls that belong to sub-agents, from merging/deleting/pushing to any system on its own initiative, and from improvising tool calls. This follows a clear least-privilege and separation-of-concerns model.
